description: Source code for a wizard in the Odoo (OpenERP) system that handles closing a project task and optionally sending a notification email to the customer.

classes.name: wizard_close
classes.description: A wizard interface class for closing project tasks and managing email notifications.

methods.name: email_send
methods.description: Function to send an email notification when a task is closed, including task details and signatures.

methods.name: _check_complete
methods.description: Checks if the task's project requires customer warning before closing.

methods.name: _get_data
methods.description: Retrieves email and description data for the task to prepare for email notification.

methods.name: _data_send
methods.description: Sends the email notification if an email address is available.

methods.name: _do_close
methods.description: Performs the actual closing of the task.
